title: Round HUD
note: One HUD for the whole round, the MVP's (the engineer's decisions of 2026-10-20 in docs/ui-decisions.md, the sketch pages/mvp-screens frames 1, 1a, 3 and 4 at 0.75: every sketch length x 1.5). s9 hides and returns the same nodes; s1 and s6 draw them as context. Every node has mouse_filter IGNORE. The top: the bare time, the anger meter exactly centred under it, the own side at the top left, every player at the top right. No points on the HUD (they show only on the mutation workbench, s11). The HUD never shows keys, walking or running, who knocked the player down, who killed whom (the engineer, 2026-10-21), a destination or task progress. HUD edges sit 39 px in (the sketch's 26 x 1.5).

states.label: Порожні руки
states.note: An alien with nothing carried; the crosshair is on an extinguisher within reach; the anger is calm (the siren off).

states.label: Предмети
states.note: Fireworks in the hand and a bun on the belt, each with its name tag; the anger rises (the siren on).

states.label: Очима людини
states.note: A human's view: the coral role sticker, the other humans tagged in the roster, a battery in the hand. A teammate's name plate keeps the old dissident mark as a visible placeholder: whether a mark over another human's head is still needed beside the roster's tag is open.

states.label: Мало здоровʼя й сил
states.note: Health at 0.22 (ramp stop 04) and stamina at 0.18.

states.label: Підняття
states.note: Decided by the engineer (2026-10-06, the wave-19 question page, q9): what the raiser sees while holding Interact next to a downed player. A thin progress bar under the crosshair in place of the object name, filling at the same rate as the downed player's raise bar (s9 raise); no text.

states.label: Копи за хвилину
states.note: The anger is full: the neighbours called the cops, and the whole party sees the countdown. Open: whether the round timer still shows beside the cops' minute, or only the one that ends first; how long the minute is.

nodes.name: Plates
nodes.note: The name plate layer (#257), under the rest of the HUD: one Plate per other player in line of sight within about 10 m. Code: position = camera.unproject_position(head + 0.35 m), the plate centred on it; hidden behind walls (raycast), beyond 10 m or behind the camera. No role, no health.

children.name: Plate
children.note: One instance per visible player, moved every frame to the projected point (the sample sits over another human at about 538, 302).

children.name: Name
children.note: The player's name from code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); no translated text.

children.name: Mark
children.note: PLACEHOLDER, open: the old dissident mark, on a human's client over another human only. Whether a mark over another human's head is still needed beside the roster's tag is the engineer's choice; drop this node if not.

children.name: Role
children.note: The player's own side for the round, a flat word sticker 39 px in (the sketch's 26 x 1.5): ToySticker with role.alien, ToyStickerAlert (coral) with role.human.

children.name: Timer
children.note: The round's time left, mm:ss from code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), every second; no plate (decided 2026-10-20): mint Rubik digits with the 6 px ink text outline, its top 33 px down (the sketch's 22 x 1.5). Rubik's digits are proportional, so the minimum width holds the widest time and the centred label never changes width.

children.name: Anger
children.note: The neighbours' anger, meter A (decided 2026-10-20): a zero-size point at the top centre, 96 px down (the sketch's 64 x 1.5). The track centres on it, so the bar is exactly centred under the time; the siren hangs off its right end without moving that centre. No caption, no plate. It never says what raises the anger or where (open: whether it hints the type of problem, the audit's point 3).

children.name: Track
children.note: The white pill track, 225 x 30 (its size constants).

children.name: Fill
children.note: value = anger / the host's threshold (0 to 1). Ongoing mischief raises it a little at a time, a one-off (the fireworks) jumps it; fixing stops the rise and the gained anger stays (m8 §5). At 1 the neighbours call the cops (Hud/Cops).

children.name: Siren
children.note: The siren, 57 px (the sketch's 38 x 1.5), 9 px right of the track's end (112.5 + 9, rounded up) and centred on its height: icons/siren-off.svg while the anger is calm (not rising), icons/siren-on.svg while it rises and when full. Never tinted.

children.name: Roster
children.note: Every player of the round with the body colour (decided 2026-10-20), 39 px in at the top right; at least 285 wide (the sketch's 190 x 1.5), growing to its longest row. The rows are built from the player list in the session's order with the own row first; a row updates when a player dies, comes back or leaves. Names are data and are not cut. Open: whether the dead show here (the page shows them dimmed with a mark).

children.name: Row1
children.note: One row: Dot is ToyRosterDot, a white disc the game tints to the player's body colour (self_modulate from data); Name is the player's name (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), the own one through hud.roster.self in ToyRosterNameSelf (green), a dead player's through hud.roster.dead in ToyRosterNameDead (lilac), else the bare name in ToyRosterName. In a human's roster the other humans and the own row carry Tag (role.human, coral); an alien's roster has no tags (humans know each other, decided 2026-10-20).

children.name: Cross
children.note: The crosshair dot, centred on the screen (its size is the variation's).

children.name: Raising
children.note: See the state raising. Shown while the player holds Interact on a downed player, in place of Aim; hidden when the key is released or the player is up. Its top sits as Aim's.

children.name: Bar
children.note: The raise progress (0 to 1), the same value the downed player's s9 Downed/V/Raise shows.

children.name: Aim
children.note: The name of the object under the crosshair within reach (an item.* key, item.extinguisher here; a mischief station or a machine takes its own key when the game adds one); hidden when nothing within reach is under the crosshair. Centred 64 px under the screen's centre, so its top is the sketch's 22 x 1.5 = 33 px under it.

children.name: Cops
children.note: The cops' minute (m8 §5.3): when the anger fills, the neighbours call the cops and every player sees this coral banner, 168 px down (the sketch's 112 x 1.5), until the cops arrive (the round ends, s10 cops) or the aliens finish first. Stalling the cops is not in the MVP.

children.name: Count
children.note: The time until the cops arrive, m:ss from code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), every second.

children.name: Vitals
children.note: The bars and the mic beside them, 39 px in at the bottom left (the sketch: bars 200 wide, the mic 244 in, x 1.5). Always shown in a round. No numbers and no captions on the bars (the engineer wants less screen): health is the green bar on top, stamina the yellow one under it, as everywhere in the game; the length is the real cue, the colour only adds to it.

children.name: Fill
children.note: value = hp (0 to 1). The fill colour follows the fraction: step = clampi(floori(hp * 20.0 + 0.5), 0, 20), Fill.self_modulate = get_theme_color("ramp_stop_%02d" % step, "ToyBarHealth").

children.name: Fill
children.note: value = stamina (0 to 1); drains while sprinting and refills at rest.

children.name: Mic
children.note: Whether anyone hears the player. On: mic.svg tinted icon_on. Off (mic off, push-to-talk released, downed, pre and post game): mic-off.svg tinted icon_off (coral). 42 px in the 75 px badge.

children.name: Slots
children.note: Item bar A (decided 2026-10-20): the hand slot (green, 150) and the belt slot (mint, 126) 16 px apart, bottoms aligned, 39 px from the right and 51 from the bottom (the sketch's 26 and 34 x 1.5), so a name tag clears the edge. A slot is a Control holding its face and its tag; an empty slot shows its faint palm or pocket and no tag. Two-handed carrying is the game's data (which items take two hands); the slot does not widen. The pictures (pack icons, never tinted) and the item.* key of each MVP item: item-battery item.battery, item-flower item.flower, item-car-part item.car_part, item-bun item.bun, item-patty item.patty, item-burger item.burger, item-watering-can item.watering_can, item-wrench item.tools (the garage's cabled tools), item-bin-bag item.rubbish, item-extinguisher item.extinguisher, item-rocket item.fireworks; item-knife item.knife only if a knife stays in the MVP (weapons are deferred, open).

children.name: Picture
children.note: The carried item's pack icon (icons/item-*.svg) at 111 px, else icons/slot-empty-hand.svg; never tinted.

children.name: Tag
children.note: The carried item's name tag over the slot's bottom edge, centred, its bottom 18 px below the face: the item's item.* key (item.fireworks here). Hidden while the slot is empty.

children.name: Picture
children.note: icons/item-*.svg at 90 px, else icons/slot-empty-belt.svg; never tinted.

children.name: Tag
children.note: As the hand's Tag (item.bun here).
